notes: Ledger of every art asset. Only CC0, generic art from no existing game. Maintained by art-engineer; checked by a Vitest validator and a CI size check (issue #80). Names are lowercase snake_case with mesh_, tex_, anim_ or sfx_ prefixes. Statuses: planned, ready, used. Entries may carry a free-text notes field. Paths are where the processed file will be placed; originals are not committed (listed by URL in Art/README.md).

assets.name: mesh_ghost
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Base: UAL1_Standard.glb mannequin (13,744 tris, 65 joints). Simplify to <=4,000 tris (tested: ratio 0.28 gives 3,847). Restyle with flat materials (dark technical clothing) and small added primitives for hood, harness, gloves and violet accent, built by a script from boxes and cylinders, no Blender. Clips to embed: Idle_Loop, Walk_Loop, Jog_Fwd_Loop, Sprint_Loop, Jump_Start, Jump_Loop, Jump_Land, Hit_Chest, Hit_Head, Crouch_Idle_Loop, Crouch_Fwd_Loop, and UAL2 ClimbUp_1m (mantle). Prune all other clips (the full file is 7 MB with 45 clips). Fallback base: Universal Base Characters Standard.

assets.name: mesh_warden
assets.author: Kay Lousberg
assets.notes: Base: Mannequin_Medium.glb (6,916 tris, 21 joints, 1 texture). Simplify to <=5,000 (tested: ratio 0.7 gives 5,051, so use ratio 0.68). Restyle: ballistic vest, helmet, radio and orange visor/trim accent added as small primitives. Clips from Rig_Medium (same skeleton): Idle_A, Walking_A, Running_A, Running_HoldingRifle, Jump_Start, Jump_Idle, Jump_Land, Hit_A, Ranged_2H_Aiming, Ranged_2H_Shoot, Ranged_2H_Shooting, Ranged_2H_Reload, Sneaking, Crouching.

assets.name: mesh_rifle
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Base: Gun_Rifle.gltf (6,194 tris, atlas T_Guns_Batch1). Simplify to <=1,500 and use a 512 px atlas or flat materials. Check there is no logo or readable text on the atlas before use. The Ghost has no weapon art.
